description.value: Breakers Resort is a collection of 11 rustic beachfront cabins at Saratoga Beach on Vancouver Island, each with fully stocked kitchens, ocean and mountain views, and most featuring wood stoves or fireplaces. The property sits directly on a safe sandy beach and is within a short drive of hiking and mountain biking terrain for all skill levels, as well as Mt. Washington for winter activities. A nearby plaza with a grocery store, pharmacy, and other services is within walking distance of the resort.
